text: These are the facts about a UK restaurant, set by its owner for an AI phone receptionist demo.
Name: The Copper Pot. Style: Modern British small plates and Sunday roasts. Town: Leeds, 14 Call Lane, Leeds LS1 6DT.

Hours: Sunday: 12 noon till 5pm. Tuesday to Thursday: lunch 12 noon till 3pm, dinner 6pm till 10:30pm. Friday and Saturday: brunch 9:30am till 11:30am, lunch 12 noon till 3pm, dinner 5pm till 11pm. Closed Mondays.
Table bookings: yes, up to 14 by phone; areas Main room, Courtyard, Bar (walk-in only), The Snug (enquiries only), Mezzanine. Walk-ins: welcome.
Click and collect: yes, 25 minutes' notice. Delivery: own drivers to LS1, LS2, LS6, LS11; on Deliveroo, Just Eat.
Deposits: per booking for parties of 8 or more. Cancel up to 24 hours before for a full refund of your deposit. A 10% service charge is added to every bill.
Children: Children are welcome until 8pm. Dogs: inside. Access: Level access, with a ramp at the side door and an accessible toilet. Parking: Pay and display on Swinegate, two minutes away.

Dress code: Smart casual. Corkage: Corkage is £15 a bottle, wine only. Cakes: Bring a cake and we will serve it with candles for £2 a head. Vouchers: Vouchers are sold online and at the bar. Dietary: Most dishes can be made gluten-free; tell us when you book.

Menu: Small plates: Whipped feta, honey and thyme, Crispy squid, Sourdough and cultured butter; Mains: Roast sirloin of beef, Chestnut and mushroom roast, Smoked haddock fish pie; Puddings: Sticky toffee pudding, Blood orange sorbet.
Write the ten questions callers most often ask a restaurant like this that the facts above answer, each with a short spoken answer (one or two sentences, friendly, British English).

Use only these facts. Where the facts do not cover something, leave that question out rather than guess. No questions about booking a table or ordering food themselves; the receptionist handles those.
